## Bio

Welcome to my page! I am a full-time MPH student at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg 
School of Public Health, concentrating in Epidemiology and Biostatistics. 
My interests center on understanding how factors beyond the clinic 
such as social determinants of health and environmental exposures shape cardiac 
and pulmonary outcomes. I am also drawn to exploring how technology, 
including artificial intelligence and mobile health applications, can be 
leveraged to improve chronic disease management. Ultimately, I hope to bridge 
my clinical experience with population-level research to develop scalable, 
community-based solutions that advance equitable patient outcomes.
